objective: Test whether exact normalization of residual owner labels from absolute player 0/1 to current-mover/opponent coordinates reduces scalar decoder complexity in the frozen ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC_ZOE representation.

exactRecoding.sourceIdentity: ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC with absolute owner-labelled residual families r0/r1
exactRecoding.targetIdentity: MOVER_ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC with residual families labelled mover/opponent before the same local-column canonicalization
exactRecoding.derivability: mu is already reconstructible from ROLE_CAPPAR+ZOE as (W*H mod 2) XOR XOR_{d:z(n_d)=O} K_d, where K_d is the XOR of role capacity-parity bits inside descriptor d.
exactRecoding.invertibility: Role capacity bits and ZOE oddness are unchanged by owner relabelling, so mu is reconstructible from the mover-relative signature as well; swapping the two owner channels again when mu=1 recovers the absolute-owner signature.

decoderModels: AFFINE_PO over mover-relative descriptor P/O bits
antiCircularity: Mover-relative owner normalization is derived from an exact symmetry of the scalar query and the already-proved rank-parity reconstruction; it is not chosen from W/D/L labels.
No descriptor feature, owner swap, capacity bit, count state, or polynomial monomial is selected using outcomes.
The complete affine, pair, and OOO cubic families are generated mechanically after recoding.
EW-RS-059 formula holdouts 3x6-k4 and 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
falsifiers: Mover-relative and absolute ROLE_CAPPAR+ZOE partitions must be equivalent on every test carrier; a class-count mismatch or non-bijective class mapping invalidates the recoding harness.
Any scalar mixed class invalidates the recoding harness because the source coordinate is Q-V exact.
Any OOO-cubic contradiction rejects the claim that the exact recoding preserves the established decoder existence result.
Degree reduction is established only if affine or degree-2 contradictions strictly decrease under the exact recoding.
nextIfDegree2Exact: Freeze mover-relative owner normalization as the preferred exact coordinate gauge and re-run cubic-target analysis only if needed for lower-degree structural interpretation; keep formula holdouts sealed until a closed decoder is frozen.
nextIfComplexityReducedButDegree2Fails: Freeze the reduced contradiction profile and compare mover-relative OOO quotient motifs before selecting any formula.
nextIfNoReduction: Retain the exact recoding as optional vocabulary only and return to OOO structural-rule discovery without changing the frozen scalar coordinate.
interpretationGuards: This experiment changes representation gauge, not semantic information.
Decoder degree is representation-dependent; any reduction is a realization simplification rather than a new Q-V quotient.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, or universal theorem follows.
